name: War-salience pilot TEXT gold (120, blind)
instructions: BLIND war-salience text gold (governor-channel pilot). Channel, period and all model output are hidden. The text is the classifier input (up to 3,000 characters; the Text length line says if it is cut). Three codes: war frame(s) (text, blank = war absent), primary mode (one), military_bio (TRUE only if the text frames the AUTHOR's OWN military service/veteran identity). An item counts as coded once the primary mode is set. WAR FRAME (text field; ids separated by |; BLANK if the war is absent -- several may apply): local_security = the war as a LOCAL safety/governance matter: alerts, attack damage, casualties, evacuation, shelters, air defence, compensation/repairs for war damage. front_support = material/social support for fighters, families, veterans, wounded: convoys, supplies, benefits, jobs, rehabilitation. military_identity = СВО participants/heroes/veterans/service as VALUE or IDENTITY: honouring heroes, «Время героев», medals/ceremonies, own service biography. war_policy = a position on the war itself: aims, victory, negotiations, mobilisation, the West/NATO as enemy. NOTE: WWII memory alone is NOT a war_frame. Full rules: code/26_content_mode.py SYSTEM_PROMPT (prompt v3). MODE (pick ONE primary): policy_specific = a concrete, checkable proposal or promise (names an instrument, sum, or deadline). issue_position = takes a side on an issue with no concrete instrument ('за справедливые тарифы'). war_stance = СВО/front/veterans/victory as the campaign's identity; (set military_bio=true if it is framed as the candidate's OWN service biography). values_ideas = patriotism, tradition, sovereignty, anti-West framing, history — ideas without a policy. constituency_service = casework/pork: 'добился ремонта двора', fixed a specific local thing, helped a specific person/group. valence_personal = competence, experience, endorsement by a senior figure, biography, likeability — no issue content. mobilization_generic = dates, turnout instructions, ДЭГ how-to, 'поддержите нас' with no substance. attack = negative/critical content about a NAMED opponent, party, or official. not_campaign = not political/campaign content at all (admin notice, unrelated repost, greeting, ad). Pointer: campaign2026/validation/DECISION_RULES_PROPOSED_2026-09-28.md (PROPOSED bars).

options.label: issue_position: side on an issue, no instrument
constituency_service: casework / fixed a specific thing
attack: negative on a NAMED opponent/party/official

validation.label: Author's OWN military service/veteran identity framed?
Notes (optional)
validation.placeholder: Ambiguity, clear model-independent oddities, dead text, etc.
